title: Seasons
subtitle: Guides for all seasons. Seasons 2 to 5 have ended.
endedText: This season has ended. The guide stays up as a reference.

seasons.name: Moonlit Elegy
seasons.intro: A vampire season with Werewolves and Succubi. The core stays as in earlier seasons: upgrade season buildings, defeat monsters and score points in glory wars.

sections.title: Monsters

items.title: Werewolf
items.text: Easier to defeat, ideal while your Serum Lab is still low. Drops Shadow Blood Crystals. The first kill of the day gives a Demon Stone.

items.title: Succubus / Knight Scubus
items.text: Harder and needs high virus resistance (Serum Lab). Drops more Blood Crystals and also gives a Demon Stone on the first kill.

items.title: Raging Leader: Serverus
items.text: The season's new boss, a vampire-themed hellhound. As in earlier seasons it appears on the map and can attack bases.

sections.note: The daily monster limit was not confirmed at launch. Earlier it was 30 in the first week and 15 afterwards.

sections.title: Season buildings: in this order

items.title: Serum Lab
items.text: Grants virus resistance. Without it you can't hit high-level monsters and so get fewer Blood Crystals. The biggest bottleneck of the season, keep upgrading it.

items.title: Shadow Spring
items.text: Mines Holy Water, one of the two resources for building upgrades.

items.title: Combat buildings
items.text: Command Center (more damage), Fire Control Center (more attack) and Defensive Fortress (more defense). Upgrade them afterwards.

items.title: The rest
items.text: After the first three, upgrade by resources.

sections.note: As in earlier seasons, personal rewards at the end depended on the season resources you collected.

items.title: Holy Water
items.text: Comes passively from the Shadow Spring and is needed for all season buildings.

items.title: Shadow Blood Crystal
items.text: Comes from defeating Werewolves and Succubi. Needed together with Holy Water for upgrades.

items.title: Demon Stone
items.text: A golden chest on the first kill of a monster. Delivered to the Mysterious Witch.

items.title: Moon Token
items.text: Created when you get a Moonlight Card you already own. Currency for the Night Market.

items.title: Times
items.text: Every day at {{apo 08:00}} and {{apo 16:00}}.

items.title: Duration
items.text: One hour in week 1, one hour longer each week. In week 8 eternal night begins.

items.title: Ranking
items.text: Weekly, by the highest Knight Scubus defeated. Only the player who starts the rally and lands the kill counts, not the participants.

items.title: Rewards
items.text: For all rewards you needed to start or join 80 rallies.

sections.title: Mysterious Witch and Moonlight Cards

items.title: Level 3: Moonlight Watcher
items.text: You can exchange Moon Watchers for Moonlight Cards.

items.title: Level 10: Moonlight Blessing
items.text: You can equip cards to your troops.

items.title: Level 21: More slots
items.text: More slots for cards equipped at the same time.

items.title: Level 33: 12 active cards
items.text: All 12 slots are open and the buffs work at 100%.

sections.note: There are 52 cards with buffs to defense, attack, HP and damage (Golden is strongest, then Purple, then Blue). The effects only lasted for this season.

items.title: Nightfall
items.text: The season's main combat event, see above.

items.title: Mysterious Witch
items.text: Deliver Demon Stones. The Glory Chest was available every 8 hours with badges and Z currency.

items.title: Demon Hunter Assignment
items.text: Special hunting assignments for rewards.

items.title: House of Dawn
items.text: Opened every Sunday.

items.title: Trading Stations and Night Market
items.text: The Night Market accepted Moon Tokens from duplicate cards.

items.title: Camila's Shop
items.text: Chest event with red fragments.

items.title: Awakening: Oliveira, Scarlett, Evely
items.text: Instead of recruitment tickets, ranking prizes were S5 awakening badges. They worked universally. You needed 5 stars to awaken.

items.title: Mastery up to level 90
items.text: The limit rose from 70 to 90. Support was the best choice for most players (shorter research, higher VIP limit). Combat paid off from level 30 for active PvP players.

seasons.name: Dinosaur Origin
seasons.intro: The longest and most complex season so far: 13 weeks on a jungle map with dinosaurs instead of zombies, many events and new systems.

items.title: Save diamonds
items.text: Season 4 was less free-to-play friendly than Season 3, mainly because Trade Hubs cost diamonds. Saving diamonds beforehand was recommended.

items.title: Three new heroes
items.text: Yu Chan (Blood Rose), Queenie (Wings of Dawn) and Amber (Guard of Order), each with their own pass and exclusive weapon. If you missed a pass, you could still unlock the heroes through fragments after about 6 weeks.

items.title: Hero Level Swap
items.text: You could permanently swap hero and skill levels between two heroes, transferring all your investment to a new S4 hero.

items.title: Biotech Lab
items.text: Grants virus resistance and decides which dinosaurs you can attack. Once you defeat level 60 dinosaurs, upgrading it further is no longer required.

items.title: Bio Greenhouse
items.text: Produces Fern Leaves, the main resource. Build all 4 from the start, the 5th came with the Wartime Investment.

items.title: Alliance Centers (×3)
items.text: Required for the Glory War. Build them as early as possible.

items.title: Combat buildings (level 60+)
items.text: Command Center (damage), Armory ×2 (attack), Fortification ×2 (defense). Don't rush them, virus resistance comes first.

sections.title: Resources and NPCs

items.title: Fern Leaves
items.text: Come from the Bio Greenhouses, the main resource for all season buildings.

items.title: Cretaceous Scales
items.text: Come from defeating NPCs on the map. The second important resource for buildings.

items.title: Velociraptors
items.text: Priority 1. Your main daily source: Cretaceous Scales and glory. Always attack the highest level you can.

items.title: Stegosauruses
items.text: Priority 2. Drop Ancient Dino Eggs and Cretaceous Scales. Share the daily limit with Velociraptors.

items.title: Predator Squads
items.text: Up to level 200 on the map. Drop season resources, eggs, blueprints and hero EXP.

sections.note: Glory Chest every 8 hours: up to 148 badges without Season Journey, doubled with the pass. If you can't beat high-level dinosaurs alone, join rallies from stronger players and you still earn glory.

items.title: Ancient Dino
items.text: Every Sunday. Everyone attacks a massive dinosaur with no attack limit. The top 3 on the first kill receive a title. The event only lasts minutes.

items.title: Dino Rescue and Black Market Guardian
items.text: The Guardian (up to level 350) needs a rally. State achievements give rewards to all players.

items.title: Dino Egg Defense
items.text: Similar to Zombie Siege. Completion matters more than ranking, and gives up to 14 Golden Wrenches.

items.title: Trade Hubs
items.text: Three levels, state-only at first, cross-state later. All purchases cost diamonds.

items.title: Fossil Album
items.text: Collect 20 different fossils from the Ancient Dino event. Duplicates turn into Ancient Dino Eggs.

items.title: Bio Institute Shop
items.text: Only open on Saturdays and Sundays, bought with Ancient Dino Eggs, 14 refreshes per weekend.

sections.title: Hatch of Legends and Glory War

items.title: Hatch of Legends
items.text: You raise a dinosaur to level 30 (T-Rex, Triceratops or Ankylosaurus, one species per season). Each level gives +1% troop attack, up to +30%. At level 16 you get a vehicle skin. It is fed with Dino Feed and Pine Cones.

items.title: Glory War
items.text: Your state was grouped with 3 other states. The wars ran every Tuesday. Higher rankings gave better rewards, including S4 recruitment tickets.

seasons.name: Snow Monsters
seasons.intro: Similar structure to Season 2, but with a focus on raids against snow bosses. The map turns into a frozen wasteland.

sections.title: Season buildings: in this order

items.title: Biological Laboratory
items.text: Grants virus resistance so you can attack higher Boomers. Boomers drop Ice Cores, needed for all buildings. The most important building.

items.title: Temperature Control Center
items.text: Produces Lotus Flowers, the main upgrade resource. Upgrade it once you have enough Ice Cores.

items.title: Combat buildings
items.text: Glacial Military Depot (attack), Glacial Fortress (defense) and Military Command (damage). Only once the Lab and Control Center are in good shape.

items.title: The rest
items.text: Upgrade by resources.

sections.note: Personal rewards at the end depended on the season resources you had stored.

sections.title: Raids: 15 rewards per day

items.title: Boomers (Snow Zombies)
items.text: Priority 1. Drop twice the Ice Cores of the Leopard. After server reset, start with 15 of them.

items.title: Snow Leopard
items.text: Medium priority. Only take the first kill once your 15 Boomer rewards are used.

items.title: Yeti (wandering boss)
items.text: Advanced, level 100 to 350. Only 2 rewards per day, and only if you take part in the final raid. Many troops end up in the hospital, only with a strong alliance.

sections.note: Yeti tip: if the Yeti approaches your base, start a raid and cancel it immediately. It then takes a different route and you avoid damage.

items.title: Snowstorm Rescue
items.text: Days 1 to 3 of Alliance vs Alliance. 10 rewards per day. Look for large ice sculptures only and share their location in alliance chat.

items.title: Mammoth sculpture
items.text: Gives 2 fragments for an exclusive season weapon.

items.title: Deer sculpture
items.text: Gives 300 badges.

items.title: Glory War
items.text: The most important event. The winner can steal season points from the loser. It decides the final ranking.

items.title: Support
items.text: Recommended for everyone. Below level 30 you are Support by default. Includes Friendship Shield, Treasure Master, cooperative building and research.

items.title: Combat
items.text: Selectable from level 30, useful for players with over 48 million hero power. Includes Emergency Recruitment (150 soldiers daily), Disguise, Quick Attack and Immediate Return.

seasons.name: Desert Guardian
seasons.intro: A desert season built around resource plots on the map instead of bosses. The desert map covers zones 1 to 320 (from zone 321 the season was ice-themed).

sections.title: Resource plots

items.title: Desert Heart (Cactus)
items.text: Main resource for most buildings. Recommended: about 70% of your plots.

items.title: Blue Crystal
items.text: Second resource, also needed for certain buildings. Recommended: about 30% of your plots.

items.title: Conquering plots
items.text: Attack with troops, after winning it takes about 10 minutes to take control. The higher the plot level, the more virus resistance you need. Other players can steal your plots.

sections.note: You start with 10 plots and the number grows over time. High-level plots run out fast and are the most contested. Adjust the 70/30 split to what you need.

sections.title: Season buildings: in this order

items.title: Virus Institute
items.text: The most important building: more virus resistance means access to high-level plots. Up to 4 institutes if your alliance has all three Alliance Centers.

items.title: Land Management Office
items.text: A higher level gives more space and more available plots.

items.title: Alliance Centers (×3)
items.text: Required for the Glory War and dependent buildings. Any alliance member can build them.

items.title: The rest
items.text: Military Fortress (more attack), Defense Training Center and Strategic Barracks, in no fixed order.

sections.note: All buildings had a maximum level of 30. The higher the level, the more plot resources you need, so plan production early.

items.title: Support
items.text: Recommended for most. More Desert Heart and Crystal production, more alliance help and virus resistance. Below level 30 you are Support by default.

items.title: Combat
items.text: Selectable from level 30, for players with high hero power. Includes Urgent Recruitment, Disguise, Quick Attack and Immediate Return.

items.title: Glory War
items.text: The most important event. The winner can steal season points from the loser.

items.title: Points
items.text: Season points are the personal glory of all members plus city points. Held cities give passive points, points already collected aren't lost when you lose a city.

items.title: Reward tiers
items.text: 7 tiers, from Supreme Legion (rank 1) through Dawn Army (2–3), Glorious Pioneer (4–5), Protection Oath (6–10), Expeditionary Alliance (11–20) and Wasteland Legion (21–50) to Wasteland Guardian (51–999).
